name: Machha Chasa Pain Nua Pokhari Khola Yojana (Matsya Pokhari Yojana)
eligibility_facts: bank account in own name in Odisha
hard_exclusions: does not fit if user already has no land/site meeting requirements
questions: Do you already have a pond, or do you need to create a new pond?
How much land is available for the pond?

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: bank account in own name in Odisha

question.en: Do you have a bank account in your own name in Odisha?
question.or: ଓଡ଼ିଶାରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ନିଜ ନାମରେ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତା ଅଛି କି?

question.en: Do you have qualifying land that is free from encumbrances for the proposed pond?

question.en: What will the pond area be, in hectares?
What will the pond's minimum water depth be, in feet?
